shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' -g '"'!*.lock'"' | head -200 && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- next docs search ---\\n' && rg -n \"revalidateTag|updateTag|Server Action|use cache|cacheTag|refresh|revalidatePath\" node_modules/next/dist/docs"

/bin/bash -lc "cat app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- layout ---\\n' && cat app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n--- db ---\\n' && cat lib/db.js && printf '\\n--- config ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- cache docs ---\\n' && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/revalidateTag.md && printf '\\n--- cacheTag ---\\n' && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheTag.md && printf '\\n--- use cache ---\\n' && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-directives/use-cache.md && printf '\\n--- forms inline actions ---\\n' && rg -n \"inline|Inline|Server Action|revalidateTag|after\\(\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/forms.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/server-actions.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides -g '*.md' | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | rg '(use-cache|cacheLife|caching.md|forms.md|server-actions.md|after.md)"'$'"' && rg -n \"inline Server Action|function.*Action|revalidateTag\\(\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/forms.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/server-actions.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/getting-started -g '*.md' | head -100 && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-directives/use-cache.mdx 2>/dev/null || true && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheLife.md && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/after.md 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | rg 'use-cache|mutating-data|server-actions|08-caching' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md && sed -n '120,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/server-actions.md && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/forms.md && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-directives/use-cache.mdx 2>/dev/null"
/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md | sed -n '1,190p' && cat tsconfig.json && cat AGENTS.md && rg --files app lib"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx next.config.ts lib/db.js && rg -n "products|revalidateTag|use cache|cacheTag" app lib next.config.ts'
